description: This file implements a lightweight recursive lock for thread synchronization, utilizing Interlocked, ThreadStatic, and SpinWait for efficient lock management in a multi-threaded environment.

classes.name: RecursiveInterlockedExchangeLock
classes.description: A lightweight, recursive lock allowing the same thread to acquire the lock multiple times without deadlocking.

methods.name: RecursiveInterlockedExchangeLock
methods.description: Constructor initializing the lock and spin condition.

methods.name: TryGet
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the lock non-blockingly.

methods.name: Get
